signatures.description: Uses Windows utilities for basic Windows functionality

T1053.long: Utilities such as at and schtasks, along with the Windows Task Scheduler, can be used to schedule programs or scripts to be executed at a date and time. A task can also be scheduled on a remote system, provided the proper authentication is met to use RPC and file and printer sharing is turned on. Scheduling a task on a remote system typically required being a member of the Administrators group on the the remote system.

We invite you to provide us with your latest company directory and confirm whether you still accept new  large orders,

Please check our specifications and track the purchase order and quote your best price as one of our partner's introduced your company to us to be reliable.

Note:
1.100% T/T in advance.
2.Delivery: 40 days.
3.Deadline for submission of quotation september 10, 2021.

Also advise the following:
1. Availability and Delivery Time.
2. Please provide picture and datasheets of your offer.
3. Advise total packing Weight and Dimension.
4. Advice Warranty period.
